title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

New roles for Senior DevOps Engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now.

Two ways to work with clients

  • Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it.
  • Direct hire: some clients hire engineers full-time, and we support you through the process.

Because companies trust our vetting, applying through Lemon.io is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own.

What you get

  • Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills
  • We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences.
  • Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours.
  • No micromanagement, no screen trackers
  • Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds
  • Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from [75+] countries

Who we’re looking for

DevOps with Python/Bash:

  • 4+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • At least 3 years of experience with Python/Golang/Bash
  • 3+ years of experience with AWS/GCP/Microsoft Azure/Azure DevOps/Kubernetes is required
  • Experience in at least 2 commercial projects using Terraform and SQL is required

DevOps or Site Reliability Engineer with Linux:

  • 4+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • At least 3 years of experience with Linux
  • At least 3 years of experience using Networking is required

DevOps/Site Reliability Engineer/Platform Engineer with Python/Golang:

  • 4+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • At least 3 years of experience with Python/Golang
  • 3+ years of experience with Kubernetes
  • At least 2 years of experience with Ceph and Networking
  • 5+ years of experience using Linux is required
  • 2+ years of experience with Terraform/Ansible/Pulumi
  • AI-assisted coding is a must

 

  • You own problems end-to-end: you spot the issue, design and build the solution, and ship it to production
  • You can show the business impact of your work with concrete results (e.g., faster processing, lower costs, more users, fewer incidents)
  • Advanced English: you discuss business tasks, explain your decisions, raise issues early, and present yourself and your results well on client calls
  • You work full-time remotely and deliver without supervision
  • You onboard quickly and start shipping in your first weeks

How it works

  1. Apply and complete your profile
  2. Verify your role
  3. Once approved, we match you with a project. Typical time to first project: 3 weeks

Ready? Apply and join the Lemon.io community.

NOT YOUR TECH STACK?

We're placing Senior Developers (4+ yrs commercial experience) across AI Agent Architecture, AI Automation Architecture, AI Engineering, Enterprise Software Engineering, React & Python, React & Golang, Golang, React & Java, React & Ruby, Ruby, PHP & Vue, Vue & Node.js, React & .NET, Android & iOS, iOS & Swift, Flutter & Firebase, Solutions Engineer, Blockchain (Ethereum/Ethers.js/Wagmi/Viem/Solana), Angular & Node.js, Vue & .NET, Python & Vue, MLOps, Data Science, Angular & PHP, Angular & .NET, Symfony & React, Symfony & Vue, Symfony & An gular, Python, Symfony & JavaScript & Next.js & TypeScript, Data Analysis, React & PHP, Data Engineering, Project Management, Product Management, QA Automation, QA Manual, Embedded Software Engineering, React Native & Node, React Native & React, React Native & Ruby, React Native & Python, WordPress, Android, Angular, Python & Node, React & Node.js, Node & TypeScript, Java & Spring, Svelte & Python, Svelte & Node.js, Svelte & TypeScript, Rust, Shopify & JavaScript, Vue & Nuxt, PHP & Laravel, UI/UX Design, Animation, Graphic Design, React & Node & React Native, .NET & C#, Electron, Scala, C++, Unreal Engine & C++, Python & LLM, Unity, or Machine Learning Engineering and more. Reach out and we'll match you.

We do not provide visa assistance, and our cooperation model does not include the benefits typically offered with direct hire.

We work with developers from 75+ countries across Europe, Latin America, North America (the U.S. and Canada), selected countries in Asia (Japan, Singapore, South Korea, the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, and Israel), Oceania (Australia, New Zealand, and Papua New Guinea), and Africa (including Morocco and South Africa).
location: Europe, LATAM, APAC, the U.S., Canada

title: Senior Backend Developer (Python)
description:
About us:

 

Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with the opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂

Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.

Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.

 

The Role:

 

We are looking for a Senior Python Developer for one of our clients. You are a perfect candidate if you are growth-oriented, you love what you do, and you enjoy working on new ideas to develop exciting products.

 

What we are looking for:

 

  • 5+ years of experience building products with Python and Django.

  • High proficiency in SQL with experience using databases like PostgreSQL.

  • Experience scaling cloud infrastructures with Docker or Kubernetes is a plus.

  • Experience managing cloud infrastructures, specifically AWS or GCP.

  • You follow the best practices and conventions.

  • Relevant experience in CI/CD and related tools.

  • Ability to work with minimal supervision.

  • Intermediate-advanced English level.

  • You can communicate well with both technical and non-technical clients.

  • Time zone: CET (+/- 3 hours). We are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Ability to build libraries and frameworks of reusable efficient code.

  • Competence in designing and implementing low-latency, stable and performing applications.

  • Capacity to effectively collaborate with other team members and stakeholders remotely.

  • Ability to implement data protection systems.

  • Competence in data storage solutions.

 

What we offer:

Predictable project hours

Flex days, so you can recharge

A one-time contracting process for endless opportunities, with no extra assessments.

 

Compensation

title: Looking For Online ESL Teachers - Remote- Joining Rewards of up to USD $100
description:
Polly English is an online English teaching company based in Singapore. We specialize in teaching English to students aged 3 to 18 across Asia, using interactive courseware inspired by Oxford Thinkers and delivered through our self-developed online classrooms. Our unique approach ensures high-interaction, high-quality classes designed to enhance students' English proficiency.

Why Join Polly English?

Our flagship offering is one-on-one online teaching, enabling us to provide customized courses tailored to each student's needs.

  • Compensation: $16–$24 per hour.

Application Process

To apply, simply follow this link: https://teach.pollyenglish.cn/website?ch_i=94f0a475a30e4c6e8d667e5793e09991

Once submitted, kindly notify us so we can expedite your application, considering your valuable teaching experience.

To welcome our new North American teachers, we're excited to offer exclusive New Teacher Rewards of up to USD $100 for teachers who join us and start teaching between August 14 and September 30.

🌟 Core Reward Rules

All rewards are subject to the following conditions:

  • Your first class must be completed by September 30.

  • No reward will be issued if the first class is not completed or is completed after the deadline.

  • No reward will be issued for class cancellations, no-shows/absences, or leaving the first class early.

💰 PPT Slot Rewards

Option 1 — Earn $50

  • Open 10 recurring PPT slots per week for 4 consecutive weeks after joining.

  • Complete your first class.

  • Have no no-shows.

  • 🎁 Reward: USD $50

Option 2 — Earn $100

  • Open 20 recurring PPT slots per week for 4 consecutive weeks after joining.

  • Complete at least 5 classes.

  • Have no no-shows.

  • 🎁 Reward: USD $100

⏳ Please complete your application within the next 2 days to meet the high demand for bookings.

Teacher Requirements

  • Native English speaker: USA, Canada.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher.

  • Certificates: Teaching or teacher qualification certificate issued by local authorities, plus an ESL certificate.

  • Experience: Over 1 year of teaching experience in local or international schools (including overseas international school experience).

Technical Requirements

  • Software: Polly English APP.

  • Hardware: Stable internet connection and Intel Core i5 (8th Gen or above). Ensure your device passes our compatibility test.

Availability

  • Peak Hours (Singapore Time):

    • Weekdays: 5:00 PM–9:00 PM.

    • Weekends: All day.

  • Minimum Teaching Hours: 10 hours during peak times.

Given your extensive teaching background, we believe Polly English would be an excellent fit for your skills and expertise. We look forward to the possibility of you joining our team and making a meaningful impact together.

If you have any questions or need additional information, please contact us at teacherrecruitment@pollyenglish.com. 

Why Now?

High Demand: Our marketing team is actively promoting classes, and newly onboarded teachers often receive bookings within 24 hours!

Limited-Time Bonus: Earn up to $50 by completing your application and opening peak-time slots (details below).

Fast-Track Approval: Apply early to maximize visibility during our upcoming promotional campaign.

 

To apply, simply follow this link: https://teach.pollyenglish.cn/website?ch_i=94f0a475a30e4c6e8d667e5793e09991

We’re here to assist you on your journey with Polly English.
